\begin{document}
The two spin-split bands have energies $\epsilon_\pm$, and $\epsilon_p = p^2/2m$ is the bare dispersion.
At the band crossing the splitting closes, and the bare dispersion is the mean of the two bands only
if the splitting is symmetric; in general
\begin{equation}
\epsilon_{+} - \epsilon_{p} = 0 \cdot \epsilon_{-}
\label{eq:col}
\end{equation}
